root.title: Canonical productive planning cutover
root.objective: Cut over daemon-owned productive planning to canonical PlanningEngine, deterministic verification and direct SemanticPlan compilation while making the legacy route unreachable and preserving regression gates.

outcomes.statement: The proposal integrates one daemon-owned canonical planning, verification and direct-compilation route.
The proposal removes productive reachability of RecursivePlanner, WorkBreakdown projection and the legacy compiler route.
The proposal preserves daemon lifecycle ownership, repository grounding and existing gates.

cut.criterion: Split at application, canonical contract and package boundaries with root-owned integration.
cut.rationale: The daemon composition, planning engine, deterministic verifier, direct compiler and lifecycle regression boundary have distinct exact write ownership and independently registered proof strategies.

children.title: Daemon planning composition and legacy retirement
children.objective: Replace the current recursive and projected productive route with daemon composition of canonical planning, deterministic verification and direct compilation while retaining repository grounding and lifecycle ownership.

outcomes.statement: The daemon composes the canonical planner, verifier and direct compiler as its proposed productive route.
Productive daemon entrypoints no longer reference RecursivePlanner, WorkBreakdown projection or the legacy compiler route.

verification.rationale: The registered static proof is the protected negative control for legacy reachability.

children.title: Canonical PlanningEngine
children.objective: Make PlanningEngine own SemanticPlan generation, canonicalization, deterministic selection and typed planning failures without a parallel WorkBreakdown output.

outcomes.statement: PlanningEngine supplies the canonical SemanticPlan portion of the only proposed productive route.

children.title: Deterministic semantic and graph verifier
children.objective: Align the SemanticPlan contract and canonical GraphRevision validation so invalid hierarchy, relations, seams and resource ownership fail deterministically before adoption.

outcomes.statement: The proposed canonical route has a separately named deterministic verification responsibility.

children.title: Direct SemanticPlan compiler
children.objective: Compile verified SemanticPlan directly into canonical GraphRevision relations without WorkBreakdown projection or LegacyGraphRevision output.

outcomes.statement: The proposed compiler consumes SemanticPlan directly and emits canonical GraphRevision material.

children.title: Daemon lifecycle and regression gates
children.objective: Adapt the transitional planning-result boundary while preserving daemon-owned lifecycle appends, immutable result adoption, repository grounding and existing gates.

outcomes.statement: The proposed cutover retains daemon lifecycle ownership and the registered regression-gate coverage.

seams.purpose: Carry the exact daemon-owned grounded planning request into PlanningEngine without transferring lifecycle ownership.

interface.promise: The daemon supplies the registered goal and exact repository view; PlanningEngine returns a typed canonical planning outcome.
interface.compatibility: No web owner, no WorkBreakdown output and no repository-view substitution.

seams.purpose: Provide the sole canonical SemanticPlan contract and deterministic verification boundary shared by planning and compilation.

interface.promise: SemanticPlan is the only planning representation and invalid graph relations are reported deterministically before adoption.
interface.compatibility: GoalContract and RepositoryView identities remain exact; WorkBreakDown projection is forbidden.

seams.purpose: Transfer the verified SemanticPlan directly from PlanningEngine to the canonical GraphRevision compiler.

interface.promise: The compiler receives SemanticPlan directly and preserves its repository-view identity in canonical GraphRevision output.
interface.compatibility: No WorkBreakdown projection and no LegacyGraphRevision output are permitted.
